# A Bundle With A Foldered Lesson

## Goal

Show both lesson forms in one bundle, so a validator that only ever sees
single-file lessons cannot pass by accident.

## Teaching philosophy

The learner reads, then explains. Nothing is built.

## Lesson map

1. Single-file lessons — the default form.
2. State merging — a foldered lesson, because it ships a worked example and a
   diagram.

## Checkpoints

There is one checkpoint, at the end.
